svg.text: A chain: the problem of flexible cognition funnels through successive mechanisms (mixed selectivity → oscillations
→ spatial computing → traveling waves/analog computation) to a final hybrid synapse/wave account of consciousness.

g.text: From synapses to waves to consciousness
